task: Enumerate ALL valid foundation/application splits of the modules in artifacts/modules.json: an assignment of every module to exactly one of layer1 (foundation) or layer2 (application), both non-empty, such that no module in layer1 depends on a module in layer2 (a dependency entry {from: a, to: b} means a depends on b).  Completeness is the deliverable: a missed item is a wrong answer.

shape.items: [{"layer1": [...], "layer2": [...]} with sorted module lists] (all of them, sorted)

evidence_requirements: E-A: one complete candidate enumeration with its method stated
E-B: a second complete enumeration of the same space produced without access to the first enumeration or any of its intermediate work
E-C: the final merged answer (union of both), with any item found by only one enumeration flagged; the completeness claim is admissible only when supported by both enumerations
